_comment: Static regime -> ordered strategy-card map for the Agent Workflow desk. Read by app.workflow.regime.load_regime_map, which validates at load that every agent_id below resolves to a real StrategyCard somewhere under backend/app/paper/library/ (base, variants, candidates, retired -- ladder/ and allocation/ hold a different card shape, AllocationCard/LadderCard, and cannot appear here; see app.tournament.results). Each list is ordered candidate-first: the orchestrator is expected to try index 0 first and fall through only if that card is unavailable (e.g. retired, or refused by app.tournament.jobs._resolve_cards for a desk_only mismatch). Ordering rationale per label: risk_on_trend leads with the two base-tier trend/momentum cards this desk already trusts most (C-trend, B-momentum) before a diversified variant; risk_off leads with the card explicitly designed for the worst-window column of the Pareto frontier before a card built to be uncorrelated with the desk's own trend/momentum legs; choppy_neutral leads with the mean-reversion card whose thesis is literally sector-SPDR chop before a tighter RSI(2) mean-reversion card; high_vol_stress leads with the card that reads its own ATR/Bollinger/RSI trio for a volatility breakout, before a card whose thesis is convexity from a systemic selloff, before a tight-stop momentum variant that cuts a trend position fast when the same instrument gets whippy. No card here is desk_only or ladder/allocation-shaped; all ten are ordinary tournament-designed StrategyCards, chosen for discipline fit only -- this map records a routing preference, not a new endorsement of any card's edge.
